name: IotaPlayer
tagline: A local-first desktop music player with MPV playback, word-level lyrics, and an intentional dark interface.
summary: IotaPlayer indexes your local audio library into SQLite and pairs native MPV playback (with an automatic Web Audio fallback) with word- and line-synchronized lyrics, a 10-band parametric equalizer, speed and pitch presets, smart playlists, library statistics, and Discord Rich Presence.

optionalDependencies.name: mpv
optionalDependencies.purpose: Primary native audio backend for broad codec support (FLAC, ALAC, Opus, WAV, etc.). Automatically falls back to the built-in Browser/Web Audio engine if unavailable.

highlights.title: Dual Playback Engine & Speed Presets
highlights.description: Plays through MPV over IPC with an automatic Web Audio fallback, 10-band parametric EQ, live spectrum visualizer, and Nightcore/Daycore/Slowed speed & pitch presets.

highlights.title: Word- & Line-Synchronized Lyrics
highlights.description: Supports Lyricsfile 1.0, Enhanced LRC, standard LRC, embedded tags, and plain sidecars with word-level highlighting, click-to-seek, and instrumental gap indicators.

highlights.title: Classic & Still Fullscreen Modes
highlights.description: Switch between the 3-pane Now Playing workspace and Fullscreen Now Playing in Classic (blurred cover backdrop) or Still (ambient dark-glass mesh with film grain) styles.

highlights.title: SQLite Library, Smart Playlists & Stats
highlights.description: Fast local indexing with Hi-Res/Lossless quality badges, Track File Inspector, rule-based Smart Playlists (ALL/ANY), and SQL-aggregated Library Format Statistics.

highlights.title: Low Performance Mode
highlights.description: Optional reduced-effects mode that disables glass blurs, ambient shaders, and visualizer loops and falls back to line-level lyrics to save GPU headroom while gaming.

highlights.title: Localization & OS Integration
highlights.description: Full English and Polish UI with system locale detection, hardware media key support via OS Media Session, and Discord Rich Presence.
